definitions.explanation: Having or showing an excessive willingness to serve or please others, often with an undignified, self-degrading manner.

examples.japanese: {卑屈|ひくつ}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧。
{卑屈|ひくつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There's no need to be so subservient.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{卑屈|ひくつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}う→振る舞う：04233_furumau⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧。
examples.english: An employee who acts servile in front of the boss.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {卑屈|ひくつ}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ - servile attitude
- {卑屈|ひくつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ - to become subservient
- {卑屈|ひくつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}う→振る舞う：04233_furumau⟧ - to behave servilely
- {卑屈|ひくつ}さ - servility (noun form)

USAGE:
Strong negative connotation. Implies undignified, groveling behavior that sacrifices one's self-respect.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {卑屈|ひくつ} - servile, cringing (negative extreme)
- ⟦{傲慢|ごうまん}→傲慢：07635_gouman⟧ - arrogant (opposite extreme)
- ⟦{謙虚|けんきょ}→謙虚：00215_kenkyo⟧ - humble (positive quality between the extremes)
